declarations.name: fn_pattern_tag
declarations.docComment:
A pattern-named tag: TypeScript reads `[a` as an optional bracket, so the
description must not start with the pattern's rest.

declarations.name: fn_single_tag
declarations.docComment: A one-element pattern's tag reads as a bracketed name, which names nothing.
